cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMMODE() BEGIN LOCAL T,S; HComplex:=1; T:=stddev({0,1},{-1,4}); HComplex:=10; S:=STRING(T); HComplex:=0; RETURN {S,STRING(T),TYPE(T)}; END;

cases.name: pair_scaling
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMMODE() BEGIN LOCAL T,U; HComplex:=11; T:=stddev({0,1},{-3,1}); U:=stddev({0,1},{-1,4}); RETURN {STRING(T),STRING(U),STRING(ABS(T))}; END;

cases.name: negative_round
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMROUND() BEGIN HComplex:=11; LOCAL T:=stddev({0,1000},{-1,3}); LOCAL R:=ROUND(T,-2); LOCAL U:=ROUND(T,-1); LOCAL V:=ROUND(T,0); RETURN {TYPE(R),STRING(R),TYPE(approx(R)),IM(approx(R)),IM(approx(U)),IM(approx(V)),approx(ROUND(ABS(T),-2))}; END;

cases.name: negative_small_round
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMROUND() BEGIN HComplex:=1; LOCAL T:=stddev({1,3},{-1,3}); LOCAL R:=ROUND(T,-2); LOCAL N:=approx(R); RETURN {TYPE(R),STRING(R),TYPE(N),STRING(N)}; END;

cases.name: zero_round
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMROUND() BEGIN HComplex:=1; LOCAL T:=stddev({0,1},{-1,9}); LOCAL R:=ROUND(T,0); LOCAL N:=approx(R); RETURN {TYPE(R),STRING(R),TYPE(N),STRING(N)}; END;

cases.name: save
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMKEEP() BEGIN HComplex:=1; L1:={stddev({1,3},{-1,3}),stddev({0,1},{-1,4}),ROUND(stddev({1,3},{-1,3}),10)}; RETURN {TYPE(L1(1)),STRING(L1(1)),TYPE(L1(2)),STRING(L1(2)),TYPE(L1(3)),STRING(L1(3))}; END;

cases.name: reopen
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_IMREAD() BEGIN HComplex:=10; LOCAL T:=L1(1), R:=approx(L1(3)); LOCAL TMP:=approx(T); LOCAL PRODUCT:=TMP*TMP; RETURN {TYPE(T),STRING(T),TYPE(L1(2)),STRING(L1(2)),TYPE(R),RE(R),IM(R),TYPE(TMP),RE(TMP),IM(TMP),TYPE(PRODUCT),ROUND(RE(PRODUCT),10),IM(PRODUCT),TYPE(IM(T)),STRING(IM(T)),approx(IM(T))}; END;
